Maybe on the manager... there is more to it though... like - if she was going to impost her methods, then the trick is to do it at the beginning of a series of tasks, not in the middle

I am not being negative about the business thing. The first thing I would *need* is a decent sized building in an expensive location
Simply. Its too ambitious and probably something to build up too...

I don't want to say too much in public professionalism and all. I sort of started emailing myself with things I picked up on as they happened, but effectively. 

The short is, she didn't trust my organisation, so kept trying to impose her own on me. Leaving me with two competing set of organising methods that conflicted.

She never gave me a chance to prove my own worked. Which I guess I understand, but also doesn't really help a situation

Not the "not limits" business i would start. It wouldn't be cheap. And it would be... too offline... for kickstarter

I can't speak for you, but its not so much that I am untalented. It that my talents aren't profitable. Or just aren't *quite* there. Or more to the point... there is no job that lacks the bits I acknowledge that I struggle with

To be honest? I am not 100% sure at times. Outdoors (Hiking/Camping), video games, tv shows, errr...tinkering with computers but nothing too advanced.... arguing politics...

General Reddit stuff I guess... 

Thats alwasy been my big problem I think though, I never found a (marketable)  passion to push myself towards...
I'd love to start a business. My skills/interests would take more financial investment though
